messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: [P0] High error rate on inference-gateway (eu-west-1). >5% 5xx for last 3m. PagerDuty triggered. War room: https://warroom.redwood.internal/rooms/abc123. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/gateway-high-errors.
Alex: paging oncall — seeing 504s/timeouts across several routes. Customers hitting long tail. Logs show queue depth spike on gateway-worker-07.
Alex: rolling tail logs: `kubectl logs -n inference gateway-worker-07 --tail=200 | grep -i timeout` — lots of "upstream timeout" and backpressure messages.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty alert assigned to Jason (sre-oncall). Incident ID: INC-2026-03-15-042.
Jason: ack'd. joining war room now. quick summary: gateway queues full, tokens per sec high, suspect batching/adapter backlog. will check metrics & routing.
Meera: I'm on comms and status page. Lia, Kate—can one of you confirm whether we have a warm fallback cluster?
Lia: we have backup-inference-eu with smaller capacity. can flip traffic, but results may be lower throughput. Suggest gradual reroute (10-20%).
Kate: I can apply a routing override in the router for 20% to backup-inference-eu. Need someone to approve on infra side (sudo).
Alex: owner: Jason. Meera: customer comms + status update. Lia/Kate: mitigation exec. I'll keep watching logs and token costs.
Jason: triage notes: metrics -> GPU queue depth and request concurrency spikes at 10:04:30 UTC. Running `htop` on gateway pod shows blocked threads. Capturing pprof and logs to /tmp/INC-042.
Jason: immediate plan: 1) enable 20% reroute to backup (temp), 2) restart gateway-worker-07 gracefully, 3) collect flamegraphs.
oncall-bot: Jason acknowledged action items. ETA for mitigation step 1: ~2m.
Kate: executing reroute now — applying routing rule: `routerctl set-weight inference-gateway eu-west-1 backup-inference-eu 20` — will monitor.
Kate: reroute applied. traffic shifted ~20%. seeing error rate drop from 5.6% -> 2.1% within 90s.
Meera: drafting status page & customer note: "We are investigating an issue affecting inference requests in EU. Some requests may return errors or experience elevated latency. We have a mitigation in place routing a portion of traffic to a backup cluster while we investigate root cause. No data loss. More updates in 15 minutes. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-03-15-042" — any edits? :eyes: 
Lia: looks good. add potential ETA for full recovery: "under investigation; next update in 15 minutes" — cool.
Alex: quick safety check — can we enable prefix KV cache for the gateway to reduce repeat token compute? Jason?
Jason: enabling prefix cache could help but requires config reload across pods — do it if rollback is quick. I'll coordinate.
Jason: action update: restarted gateway-worker-07 gracefully (SIGTERM -> drain). reconciling connection pools. collecting pprof now.
Kate: after restart and reroute, error rate stable at ~1.2%. latency slightly increased for some requests but overall success rate improved.
Meera: posted status page update: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-03-15-042/updates/1 — customers notified via email list A/B. Draft of customer email posted in war room.
Meera: customer notification draft (posting here for approval): "We are currently experiencing intermittent errors and higher latency for inference requests in EU. We have routed a portion of traffic to a backup cluster which has reduced errors. Our engineers are investigating root cause and will provide an update within 15 minutes. We apologize for the disruption and will share full post-incident details."
Alex: +1. keep it factual and short. add "no customer data was exposed" line.
Lia: monitoring notes: error rate drop persists for 6m. spike windows at request bursts > 2k rps. suggests batching misconfiguration under burst.
Jason: collecting config diffs and recent deploys. timeline: last deploy to router 2026-03-15T09:58Z — checking if it coincides.
oncall-bot: Reminder: if mitigation holds for 30m and no regression, reduce severity to P1 and start postmortem channel prep.
Kate: infra gave sudo to apply the routing. will keep the 20% reroute for 15 minutes then evaluate.
Jason: next steps: keep monitoring metrics (error rate, p50/p95 latency, GPU queue depth), finish flamegraphs, and if stable after 30m hand off to follow-up rotation. Lia/Meera/Kate please standby for 15m checks.
Meera: I'll send next customer update in 15m. Draft pinned in war room.
Jason: if anything spikes again, escalate to infra-eng PagerDuty bridge and increase traffic diversion.
Alex: noted. I'll prep an internal comms template for execs: "Incident INC-2026-03-15-042: EU inference errors, mitigation in place (20% traffic to backup), impact reduced. Next update in 15m."
Lia: ready to take handoff at 30m if stable. Priya is next on rotation after Jason.
Kate: monitoring dashboards linked: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/xyz/gateway-eu?orgId=1 — keeping eyes on it.
incident-bot: UPDATE: Mitigation applied; errors reduced to ~1.2%. War room remains open: https://warroom.redwood.internal/rooms/abc123. Please react with :thumbsup: when you have read this thread.
Jason: closing initial triage. continuing investigation in war room. will update thread at 15m or on any regressions.
Meera: thanks team — coordinating customer comms now.
Alex: good job.
